verdict.rationale: There is evidence of a desktop 'Codex App' (codex-gh-8/10) and community reports of it listing multiple project threads/sessions in a sidebar (codex-comm-18), plus doc mentions of diff inspection for tasks (codex-docs-5) and git checkpoints (codex-docs-40). However, no evidence explicitly confirms a visual side-by-side diff viewer or running multiple sessions concurrently in split-pane view within the desktop app. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a visual diff UI in the desktop app, and explicit side-by-side/multi-pane session support rather than just a session list.
